scope: Scoped JAVA2D FacetMarks workflow and technique transfer; no source-pixel reproduction, external survey-image comparison, other-renderer/target or release claim.

baseline.observation: Connected coloured triangular faces with a polygonal disc-derived hull; varying face sizes and thin raster seams are visible.

wire.observation: Same outer shape and internal connectivity drawn as fine unique coloured edges.

grain.observation: Light sparse coloured points occupy the same hull; face regions are subtle, with no fill/wire overlay.

colour.observation: Changed face colours with unchanged boundaries.

sites.observation: Dark markers coincide with face vertices, including hull vertices.

fine.observation: Many smaller facets; denser site set expands the sampled hull toward the circle.

new-seed.observation: Different site arrangement, facets and polygonal outline.

cells.observation: Cell-centre source produces rectilinear alignment, clustered small faces and broad triangular regions.

cells-wire.observation: Unique edges reveal the aligned cell-centre structure and broad connecting triangles.

cells-grain.observation: Light point texture occupies the cell-centre hull, with broad colour regions.

cells-fine.observation: Grain covers a fuller near-rectangular hull after additional cell subdivisions; texture remains light.

cells-colour.observation: Alternate muted colours in the same fine cell-centre grain geometry; change is subtle at this point size.

root_corrections: Replaced finite-only draft probe with exact returned-coordinate and native style verification.
Corrected expected control persistence: fine and grain remain active during later cell edits.

limitations: Grain is intentionally pale; fine-cell palette changes are subtle. No dense-shading claim.

No city/prism/window, halo, circle clipping or constrained triangulation claim.
No human usability session; ports and other milestones remain.
